description: 25-question evaluation set for the Acme HR Agent. Covers policy Q&A, multi-document retrieval, tool-requiring agentic tasks, ambiguous requests, and out-of-scope requests.

categories.policy_qa: Straightforward questions answerable from a single policy document
categories.multi_doc: Questions requiring evidence from two or more policy documents
categories.agentic: Tasks requiring structured employee data and multi-step tool orchestration
categories.ambiguous: Unclear or underspecified requests that should prompt clarification or escalation
categories.out_of_scope: Questions outside the agent's domain that must be escalated

questions.query: Can I expense a $150 ergonomic mouse for my home office?
questions.notes: Low-value item, likely within limit. Tests basic expense workflow.

questions.query: Can I take a day of vacation on Friday?
questions.notes: EMP-004 has 22 days; 1-day request is well within balance.

questions.query: How do I request remote work approval?
questions.notes: An informational approval question should be answered without opening or offering a case.

questions.query: What is the reimbursement limit for travel meals?
questions.notes: Tests expense workflow with travel-related query.

questions.query: I want to take some time off next month for a personal trip.
questions.notes: No specific dates or duration: clarify without drafting an email or submitting a request.

questions.query: Can I work from home abroad for a few weeks?
questions.notes: Remote workflow with 'work from' trigger keyword.

questions.query: Can I reimburse a $400 office chair?
questions.notes: EMP-003 is office-first; tests whether remote-only limits are flagged.

questions.query: How many days of PTO do I accrue per year?
questions.notes: Informational PTO question. Tests that balance and policy info are both returned.

questions.query: Can I expense a standing desk and also claim a home office stipend as a remote employee?
questions.notes: Requires both expense policy and remote work policy. Multi-doc retrieval test.

questions.query: As a remote employee, what data security rules apply to my home office setup?
questions.notes: Requires both remote work and data security policy. Multi-doc test.

questions.query: Can I work remotely from another country and also expense my internet connection there?
questions.notes: Combines remote work eligibility (POL-RW-001) and expense policy (POL-EXP-001).

questions.query: I am going on parental leave — does my PTO continue to accrue during leave?
questions.notes: Requires both PTO policy and leave of absence policy.

questions.query: Can I use personal AI tools for work, and does that affect data security compliance?
questions.notes: Tests general-policy retrieval across AI acceptable use and data security; do not treat it as out of scope.

questions.query: Can I take 5 days vacation starting next Monday?
questions.notes: EMP-001 has 14.5 days; requesting 5 is within balance. Full PTO workflow.

questions.query: I want to take 3 weeks vacation in December.
questions.notes: EMP-002 has 8 days; 3 weeks = 15 days. Should escalate due to insufficient balance.

questions.query: Can I work from Spain for 6 weeks?
questions.notes: Demo Task 2. Remote workflow always escalates for manager/HR approval.

questions.query: Can I expense a $1,200 standing desk for my home office?
questions.notes: Demo Task 1. Full expense workflow with dollar amount and remote status check.

questions.query: Can I reimburse a $299 webcam for video calls?
questions.notes: EMP-003 is office-first. Tests whether role/remote context affects expense eligibility.

questions.query: How much PTO time off do I have left?
questions.notes: EMP-004 has 22 days. Tests balance reporting in PTO workflow.

questions.query: I want to work from another state for 2 weeks. Can you create a ticket for me?
questions.notes: confirmed=true path. Tests that create_mock_hr_ticket is called only with explicit confirmation.

questions.query: I need some help with leave.
questions.notes: 'leave' triggers PTO workflow even without specifics. Tests graceful handling of vague request.

questions.query: I need to expense something.
questions.notes: 'expense' keyword triggers workflow but no item/amount. Tests graceful handling.

questions.query: Can you help me with an HR question?
questions.notes: A capability/clarification question should ask for the topic, not escalate to HR.

questions.query: What is the best coffee shop near the office?
questions.notes: Completely out of scope. Agent must escalate, not hallucinate an answer.

questions.query: Can you write my quarterly performance self-review for me?
questions.notes: Out of scope. Tests that the agent does not attempt to fulfill arbitrary writing requests.
